title: Knowing Louis from the Waifs' Home before the Army
summary: Punch first met Louis in the Waifs' Home; Louis was just a bad boy who could not yet play, and Kid Rena was there.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: So, you're older than Lewis. That's right. But since you were in the Army, you got started in music.
You see, when I come from the Army, Lewis was in New Orleans at a place called the 25, playing there.
That's when I met him. Huh? Had you heard of him when you met him? Oh, yeah.
I knowed him before I left New Orleans. Was he a big star? No, he wanted nothing then. Oh, no.
How did you know him then?
Well, we all was in homes a while.
He caught me on the street, but I wasn't in there but two weeks.
Oh, and the Waves' home together?
Homes, yeah. Old Man Jones' home. Oh, and Jones' home and the Waves' home together?
You were there. You knew him then?
Sure, that's where I first met him. But he couldn't play on the horn. He was just a bad boy, you know.
Well, who else was a bad boy in the home?
